Shankaracharya Gate
historical
Ein verziertes Tor an der Grenze zwischen Nepal und Indien, das als symbolischer Eingang zur Stadt Birgunj dient.
Egy díszes kapu a nepáli-indiai határon, amely Birgunj városának szimbolikus bejárataként szolgál.
O poartă ornamentată situată la granița dintre Nepal și India, servind drept intrare simbolică în orașul Birgunj.
An ornate gateway at the Nepal-India border, serving as the symbolic entrance to the city of Birgunj.

landmark

This temple dedicated to Lord Shiva houses a central lingam and is decorated with colorful carvings.
